observations.evidence: task.md Evaluation section: AUC per label, averaged; the *100 and *50 prediction scalings in v12-v21 therefore cannot change the score.

action_summary: Restored the proven ImageNet normalization (mean [0.485,0.456,0.406], std [0.229,0.224,0.225]) that produced the best score (0.96062 at v13/v14); all six later normalization tweaks regressed the leaderboard. Added multi-resolution TTA: images are loaded at 640 and also evaluated at 512 via on-GPU interpolation, each with horizontal flip, and sigmoid probabilities are averaged. Added automatic fold ensembling: all resnet200d*.pth checkpoints in the public checkpoint dataset are loaded and averaged, falling back to the single fold4 checkpoint if none are found. Enabled autocast fp16 on GPU and reduced batch size to 32 to keep the extra TTA within memory/time. Dropped the irrelevant *100 output scaling (AUC is rank-based) and write plain probabilities in the required submission format.
